title: QSO Graph owner list (QG Reference)
description: One owner's published list of codes (CQ zones, ITU zones, DARC DOKs), as facts transcribed from the owner's document. Every record cites where it appears in that document. The same shape for every owner list; see qso-graph-devel planning/QSO-GRAPH-REFERENCE-DATA.md section 5.

document.description: The owner's document these facts come from (its file name in published/)

edition.description: The document's own date or version

name.description: The owner's name for the code, as published

replaced_by.description: A code this one was merged into or replaced by, when the owner says so

attributes.description: List-specific columns as the owner publishes them (e.g. a DOK's district and club)

source.description: Where this record appears in the owner's document

transcription_note.description: Ours: a note on reading the owner's text (e.g. an evident typo kept as published)

pas.description: ADIF Primary_Administrative_Subdivision code, when the owner names one

prefix.description: The prefix as the owner writes it

boundary.description: The owner's own wording for a partial area (e.g. 'north of the 50th parallel')
